277949766.description:
TDK, Maxell, and Memorex Blank Audio Cassette Tapes
10 Piece Lot with Storage Case
Type I and Type II Formulations
This collection features 10 vintage blank audio cassette tapes from leading manufacturers TDK, Maxell, and Memorex. These tapes represent the standard for analog home recording from the late 1980s through the 1990s, offering a mix of Type I Normal Bias and Type II High Position (Chrome) formulations. The lot is accompanied by a TDK-branded soft nylon carrying case designed for secure storage and transport of a cassette library.
5 TDK High Position Type II tapes: includes two SA-90 and three SA-X100 cassettes
4 Maxell UR 90 Normal Bias Type I tapes for everyday recording
1 Memorex dB C60 Normal Position Type I ferric cassette
TDK/Coast branded black nylon soft case with zipper closure and internal organizers
Condition:
All 10 cassette tapes are factory sealed in their original cellophane packaging. The nylon storage case is in good condition with a fully functional zipper and intact interior slots. The external branding and logo patches are clear and legible. Sold as-is due to the nature of vintage magnetic media.

- Condition: Mixed raw and partially polished

Tubes show signs of wear and oxidation, with handwritten notes on bases indicating previous use and condition, such as 'R. Final 2C39 5-20-85 USED' and '+V.G.++'. All tubes appear structurally intact but are sold as used and may require testing or refurbishment before operational use.
